source_review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, same author; explicit public specification and algorithm review
source_review.algorithm_assessment: Odd-only Eratosthenes with bytearray slice marking; at most 50MB main sieve at N=1e8.
source_review.limitations: Single reviewer plus isolated execution; not two independent semantic reviews, not proof of universal correctness.
source_review.boundary_choice: Codex explicitly selects the first fully visible prime-counting implementation boundary. The production parser accepts the original command and its decoded Python compiles. Its algorithm counts all integers up to N using trial division for each, unsuitable for the public N<=1e8 constraint. The replacement odd-only sieve is grounded solely in that visible task and needs no later execution information. Earlier erroneous protocol/escaping review rationales are excluded; no claim that these were actual defects.
